topics.headline: Oil shock from Iran conflict points to both US CPI and HICP rebounding
topics.summary: Renewed Iran-linked oil and gasoline price spikes make a July rebound in US CPI (from 3.5%) likely, while Eurozone HICP (from 2.8%) faces similar upside energy pressure per ECB's own 3.4% peak forecast; both readings out July 31 (flash HICP) and August 12 (CPI) will test whether this energy pass-through hits simultaneously.

topics.headline: HY spreads near tights, but supply and Fed risk loom
topics.summary: At 2.68-2.73%, HY OAS sits near historic tights even as record $53B weekly issuance strains absorption and hedge funds unwind tech positions at a decade-scale pace; a hawkish July 29 FOMC decision (hike-vs-hold split 9-8) adds near-term widening risk within the 30-day window.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETFs extend seven-day, ~$1B inflow streak, but momentum is fragile
topics.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have posted net inflows for seven straight sessions (~$981M-$999M), led almost entirely by IBIT, but the streak is small next to 2026's $4.84B in outflows and a prior $5B+ seven-day run, while BTC has slipped to ~$64,700 and sentiment is cooling ahead of the July 28-29 FOMC meeting.

topics.headline: VIX spikes 12% to 18.70 as Iran conflict roils markets
topics.summary: VIX jumped from 16.64 to 18.70 as Middle East escalation and weak hyperscaler cash flow (Tesla, Alphabet) hit stocks, pushing it above its 16.94 trailing 3-month average; historically such geopolitical/earnings-driven spikes fade quickly, but a protracted Iran conflict could keep VIX elevated near-term.

topics.headline: OpenAI signs 25-year, 3.2GW Georgia Power deal for Project Camellia
topics.summary: Deal velocity remains extremely high, with OpenAI's $20B+ Georgia Power PPA landing days after Microsoft's Chevron deal and Crusoe's 5GW UPS partnership—confirming this trend resolves YES with near certainty each 30-day window, though OpenAI's 57:1 commitment-to-revenue gap flags growing financial strain behind the headlines.
